findings.finding: This is Shervin Korangy's first print, three weeks after a board-forced CEO change. The deputy supervisory board chair said publicly that Giza had 'no new ideas, no vision' and that cost-cutting was not enough, and Citi reads the board's statements as a shift from cost and margins to revenue growth and reinvestment. That makes a reframing of 2027 or of the 2030 aspirations (consensus FY2027 OI EUR 2,121m, +3%) the likeliest new line in this release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The CEO change itself took the stock -6.85% on 2026-10-07 and -1.87% the next day. Prints have moved -9.85% (Nov 2025), +3.55% (Feb 2026, guide year), -10.68% (May 2026) and -7.58% (Aug 2026, beat sold on volumes).
findings.original_quote: Giza habe "keine neuen Ideen, keine Vision" gehabt und "Sparzwang" reiche nicht ... Laut Veronika Dubajova von der Citigroup deuten die Aussagen des Aufsichtsrats nun darauf hin, dass sich der Fokus des Unternehmens weg von Kosteneffizienz und Margen und hin zu Umsatzwachstum und Reinvestitionen verschieben dürfte. [Translation: Giza had 'no new ideas, no vision' and 'cost-cutting pressure' is not enough ... According to Citigroup's Veronika Dubajova, the board's statements suggest the company's focus is likely to shift from cost efficiency and margins to revenue growth and reinvestment.] Also: 'Schließlich habe der Dialysekonzern gerade ein Quartal beendet, das als schwierig befürchtet worden sei' (JPMorgan, Adlington). [Translation: after all, the dialysis group had just finished a quarter that was feared to be difficult.]
findings.why_not_priced: The stock has fully retraced the CEO-change drop (37.42 on 10-07 to 40.49 at seal) and the 2027 consensus still has OI growing about 3%. If the market had priced a reinvestment reset, the 10-07 low would have held and FY2027 estimates would have come down in the Vara set dated 10-22. Neither happened. The caveat is that this is inference from board and sell-side language, not a company statement, so the size is held well below the guidance scale.
findings.independence: Börsen-Zeitung (different outlet) reports that the strategy 'did not ignite' and that FME fell behind DaVita, and expects Korangy to close the gap: https://www.boersen-zeitung.de/unternehmen-branchen/us-dialyseplan-belastet-fresenius-medical-care. The company's own release frames the next phase as 'accelerating long-term profitable growth' under 'a different leadership profile': https://www.freseniusmedicalcare.com/en/media/newsroom/shervin-j-korangy-appointed-ceo-of-fme-to-lead-the-next-phase-of-strategic-development-and-long-term-profitable-growth/

findings.finding: The CMS CY2027 ESRD PPS final rule (Oct 28) raised the LDO rate +3.5% against +1.9% in the draft, raised the net market basket +1.9% against +1.1%, and nearly doubled the DefenCath add-on, which is supportive for any 2027 commentary. FME called it 'largely in line with our expectations'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FME +2.14% and DVA +5.10% on 2026-10-29, the session after the rule. That is already priced.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock rose on the day and the company said it was in line with its expectations. Only the translation into a 2027 frame on the call is new, hence the small size.

findings.finding: HHS's Kidney Care National Plan (Oct 20) aims to lower market-entry barriers for new providers, push home dialysis and increase competition. UBS called it a 'new and significant risk' for FME and DZ Bank an increased risk. Expect call questions; no economics are attached yet.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FME was down as much as 4.2% intraday on 2026-10-21 and closed -2.56%; it recovered since.
findings.original_quote: Die UBS wertete die US-Pläne als ein neues und erhebliches Risiko für den Dialyseanbieter, auch wenn ein erster veröffentlichter Entwurf zu den Plänen noch in einem frühen Stadium zu sein scheine und wenig konkrete Details enthalte. [Translation: UBS saw the US plans as a new and significant risk for the dialysis provider, even though a first published draft appeared to be at an early stage with few concrete details.]
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: there was a day-of reaction and then a recovery. The residual is whether management quantifies any exposure on the call, which it is unlikely to do.
findings.independence: FME's own statement welcoming the plan, 2026-10-20: https://www.freseniusmedicalcare.com/en/media/newsroom/statement-regarding-hhs-kidney-care-national-plan/

findings.finding: DaVita's Q3 (Oct 29) shows the US market growing slowly (normalized non-acquired treatment growth +0.4%), with sequentially lower revenue per treatment, patient care cost per treatment up $2.82 on medical supplies, and the low end of the OI guide raised. It confirms FME's peer gaining share while FME's same-market volumes are guided at about -0.9%. DVA fell -3.0% the session after its print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: US same-market volume was the line that took FME -7.58% on 2026-08-04 despite a 10% OI beat. FME fell -2.58% on 2026-10-30, alongside DVA's post-print -3.0%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: FME traded down with DVA on 10-30. What is left is that a peer at +0.4% leaves FME's -0.9% looking like continued share loss, which the market already assumes.

baseline_tension: The small negative lean cuts against priced_lean_pct +1.5, which comes from a modest, flat 2.55% short and a flat run-up (+0.6% over 20 days). It is not a crowded short, so there is little squeeze fuel, but the lean is from proxies and inference, which is why p_up is only 44 and the scaled number (-0.9) is smaller than the findings' sum (-1.4).
language_note: The German dpa-AFX roundup (boerse-online.de) carried the analyst colour the English results did not surface: JPMorgan's Adlington calling Q3 a quarter 'als schwierig befürchtet' (feared to be difficult), and Citi's Dubajova reading the board as shifting from margins to growth and reinvestment. Those two lines are the basis of the main finding.

Reporting in German quoted deputy board chair and works-council member Stefanie Balling ('keine neuen Ideen, keine Vision') and Handelsblatt company sources saying the CMD strategy 'nicht gezündet' (did not ignite). The Balling quote is attributed to Reuters, so an English wire probably carried it too; I did not verify the English version.

The bar (the company-hosted Vara consensus), the CMS rule, the DaVita read-through and the Q2 call came from English or company sources.
